caption_too_long.prompt: A person is standing, steps forward with their right foot while holding their hands cupped at their chest. They then turn to the right and lean back, simultaneously opening their left arm to the left and raising their right hand to their side up to a certain height. Next, they throw forward with their right arm, and then let both arms fall naturally. Afterwards, they step forward with their right foot again, bringing their hands together at chest height, before letting both arms fall naturally.

A person clasps their hands forward and to the right in a catching motion, then performs an underhand throw forward with their right hand, then repeats the catching motion and throws with their right hand from an upper position, and repeats the first action.

A person is waving to greet. First, they stand with feet apart, raise and wave their right hand. While waving, the whole arm with the hand swings gently outward, then they beckon for them to come over.

This person stands in place, raises both hands to their chest as if catching an object, then raises their right hand and throws forward, then catches an object with both hands again and throws it upward, and immediately after, they put their left hand to their mouth and walk forward.

A person is standing, raises their right hand with the palm facing inward, waves it back and forth in front of them, then backhands with the palm facing outward, waving to the left-rear, and finally repeats the same motion continuously.

A person is standing, then waves their right hand from side to side, then raises their right hand with the palm facing inward and waves it back and forth, then waves their right hand from side to side again.

A person stands with both hands in front of their face, and alternately swings them forward. The right hand swings forward and upward from the waist, the left hand swings forward and upward from the waist, and then these actions are repeated.

A person holds their hands in loose fists in front of their chest, extends their right hand forward three times, then their left hand three times, then repeats it, extending the right hand three more times.

This person is boxing, they bend their knees and continuously move their legs left, right, forward, and backward, while alternately swinging their hands forward in front of their chest and dodging from side to side, then performs an uppercut with the right hand, followed by an uppercut with the left hand.

A person is playing catch. They first bend their knees and bow, place their hands in front to catch an object, then stand up, raise their left hand forward, place their right hand by their side, turn their body to the right and swing forward, then take a step back, catch an object again with both hands in front, and then swing their right hand to throw it upward from a low position.
